scheme_name.en: Haryana EV Policy – Motor Vehicle Tax Exemption

description.en: Haryana Electric Vehicle Policy-2022 (Industries & Commerce / Transport pathway; gazette 8 Jul 2022, effective 10 Jul 2022 for five years) exempts Motor Vehicle Tax under the Haryana Motor Vehicle Tax Act, 2016 for eligible EVs purchased and registered in Haryana during the policy period within notified first-vehicle quotas (policy text: 100% for e-2W first 30,000 and e-3W first 15,000; 75% for e-4W/FCEV first 10,000; 25% for hybrid e-4W first 2,500; 75% for e-buses first 1,000 — VERIFY live remaining quota). Discounted registration fees are also notified. Middle-class private buyers — not a BPL scheme. Distinct from skipped HWDCL education-loan (non-.gov.in host).

Discounted registration fees are also notified. Middle-class private buyers — not a BPL scheme. Distinct from skipped HWDCL education-loan (non-.gov.in host).
